item.title: National Lab Sustains Plasma for 12 Minutes in Compact Tokamak Test
item.dc:creator: Office of Science
item.description: Researchers sustained a plasma discharge for 12 minutes at an on-coil field of 20 T, using REBCO high-temperature superconducting tape. The campaign concluded in March 2026.

item.title: Grid-Scale Sodium-Ion Battery Installed at Three Utility Sites
item.description: A 20 MWh sodium-ion system is now operating at three utility sites in Texas.
